caption: The video captures a calm lake, a snow-capped mountain range under a clear blue sky, and a golden-brown grassy hill on the left. A small cluster of buildings and trees sits along the right shore, while a thin bare branch rises in the lower-right foreground and reeds appear in the lower-left. The mountains and hillside are mirrored in the dark blue water, and the reflection of the peaks continuously wavers and distorts. This movement is visible from the first frame onward, showing small ripples already present on the lake surface. The actual mountains, hill, sky, and right-shore buildings remain fixed in the same image positions. The camera framing stays essentially static, and the foreground branch and reeds do not move. Across the excerpt, the reflected peaks shift in shape and brightness, while the landscape remains unchanged.
relations: Small ripples on the lake surface cause the reflected peaks to continuously waver and distort.
Static camera framing keeps the actual mountains, hill, sky, and right-shore buildings fixed in position.
The foreground bare branch and lower-left reeds remain motionless throughout the sequence.
